description: Create a QR code that enrolls a new or factory-reset Android device into this company under the given policy. Each call creates a new enrollment token that stops working 24 hours later, so create one only when the user asks for a QR code to enroll devices, and never reuse an older one. The QR image is delivered to the user directly with this result: do not describe, transcribe or rebuild it. To use it, tap the welcome screen of the device's setup wizard six times and scan the code. VR-only policies cannot be provisioned with a QR code. A personal (BYOD) device that is already set up needs no QR code and no reset: it gets a work profile from the policy's Personal enrollment link and token in the portal (New device > Personal).

company.description: Optional: a `company` value from list_companies to run this in. Omit it for the connection's own company.

personalUsage.description: Company-owned device with a work profile that keeps the user's personal data separate (ALLOWED, also called COPE), company-owned fully managed device (DISALLOWED), or dedicated device without a user account (USERLESS). Omit for the default (UNSPECIFIED). Every value enrolls a new or factory-reset company device: a personal (BYOD) device does not enroll with a QR code.

policyId.description: Path name of the policy the device enrolls with - the "pathName" returned by list_policies.

wifiHidden.description: Whether wifiSsid is a hidden network. Defaults to false.

wifiPassword.description: Password of wifiSsid. Only a password the user gave in this conversation; never guess it.

wifiSecurity.description: Security of wifiSsid. Defaults to WPA when a password is given, NONE otherwise.

wifiSsid.description: Optional Wi-Fi network the device joins during setup. Only when the user asks for it.

title: Create provisioning QR code
